Velautham Sivarajah, Returning Officer, Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha. District Election Office, Kilinochchi, 02nd November, 2026. Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer, Damana Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Ampara, 04th November, 2026. A. Ayantha Anandi, Returning Officer, Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Gampaha, 13th of November, 2026.
